mechanism_narrative: A further drop in WORKPLACES over the next four weeks will reduce weekday trip chaining and discretionary lunch shopping, pushing RETAIL_REC below its last-four-week average.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES is -45.0 at t-0w after -22.3 at t-1w
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES recovers toward baseline while RETAIL_REC still falls over the next 28 days, this mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT falls more than 10 points week-on-week, retail access worsens and nonessential shopping declines within two weeks, lowering RETAIL_REC relative to the prior four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT moved from -33.6 at t-1w to -45.6 at t-0w
failure_condition: If a TRANSIT drop greater than 10 points is followed by stable or higher RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days, reject the hypothesis.

mechanism_narrative: A joint decline in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES compresses daytime foot traffic corridors, and that interaction lowers RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks more than either series alone.
evidence_refs: fact:Both series are sharply below baseline at t-0w
failure_condition: If both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES remain depressed but RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days, the interaction claim fails.

mechanism_narrative: If RESIDENTIAL stays above +10 while WORKPLACES stays below -20, home-centered substitution dominates and retail visits weaken within one week, lowering RETAIL_REC.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL is 16.1 and WORKPLACES is -45.0 at t-0w
failure_condition: If the stated residential-workplace split persists yet RETAIL_REC does not fall in the next 7 days, reject the hypothesis.

mechanism_narrative: A regime of sharply depressed transit, proxied by TRANSIT below -40, suppresses casual retail trips for the next four weeks and keeps RETAIL_REC below its recent average.
failure_condition: If TRANSIT remains below -40 while RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in PARKS after a weak week signals improved leisure weather and spillover shopping traffic, lifting RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises by at least 5 points from the prior week
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS was -14.9 at t-0w after -9.1 at t-1w
failure_condition: If PARKS rises by 5 or more points from a low week but RETAIL_REC does not improve within 14 days, reject the claim.

mechanism_narrative: When GROCERY_PHARM and PARKS both weaken together, combined errand and leisure substitution away from shopping districts reduces RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM fell to -5.9 and PARKS fell to -14.9 at t-0w
failure_condition: If GROCERY_PHARM and PARKS both remain weak but RETAIL_REC increases over the next 28 days, the mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A one-week improvement in WORKPLACES above its prior week, combined with stable RESIDENTIAL mobility, restores weekday shopping routines and raises RETAIL_REC within four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES turns up week-on-week while RESIDENTIAL stays within 2 points
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES was -45.0 at t-0w and RESIDENTIAL was 16.1 at t-0w
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES rises week-on-week and RESIDENTIAL remains stable but RETAIL_REC does not improve over 28 days, reject the hypothesis.
